d: Young man breaks out of prison and manages to keep hidden for over a week. His reason for breaking out is that his ex-girlfriend has started dating his father again.

t: True Nordic Crimes: Footprints in the Snow
d: In the early morning hours on a dark and cold day the forensic officer of the Police force is called out to a break in at a garage. A few hours later he is called out again, but this time there is a dead body, brutally murdered, lying on the pavement.
This episode features a woman who shot her abusive husband and a bipolar woman who killed her 5-year-old stepdaughter after an argument.
This episode features a woman who murdered her own parents and a woman who helped her husband commit robbery and murder.
This episode features a woman who was convicted of murdering her millionaire husband and a woman who was an alleged accomplice in the fatal beating of a man held captive in her home.
A female cab driver is convicted of masterminding a cruel plot to murder a wheelchair user. Then, a woman robs and kills a liquor store clerk.
This episode features a mother who shot her two sons dead and a woman who allegedly set a fire that killed her boyfriend and his parents.
A woman and her husband are charged with beating a gay man to death. Then, a mother is convicted of the murder of her 8-month-old child.
This episode features a woman who murdered her husband and another who schemed to kill a witness in her nephew's murder case.

This episode features a woman who was convicted in the murder and dismemberment of a 21-year-old man. Then, a woman claims that she shot and killed her husband in self-defense.
Amanda Reese breaks out in hives and begins to hyperventilate after returning from a Hurricane Katrina relief effort. Dr. G wonders if an infection caused this young woman’s untimely death.

Dr. G must figure out if a decomposed body is that of a local missing woman and if she was murdered.
During her career as a medical examiner, Dr. G has autopsied thousands of murder victims. In this episode, Dr. G shares her most memorable case.
Dr. G reviews a woman's medical records and learns that she suffered from an auto-immune disease called lupus, which might have something to do with her death.

st: Cornered: The Case of Darlene Ellis
d: Explore the case of an abused California woman who killed her husband is examined.
